description: Org servers, the org key ring and the audit export (docs/enterprise-accounts.md). Uses org-authority/vectors.json: its keys, chains[0].entries[0..1] (v0, v1) and seatBooks[0]'s grants [M, S]. serverCodes: verifyOrgServerCode(state, book, code, approvals, now). register: verifyOrgServerRegister(request, signature) with an Ed25519 STK from seed 5e*32. kems: verifyOrgSeatKem / verifyOrgBoxKem (STK above). keyRings: verifyOrgKeyRing(ctx, bundle, prev, {fresh}) with ctx = state, seat book (grants [M, S] + revokes), newest KEM keys, servers [home, other] at now. rotations: orgRotationDone over buildOrgKeyRings(ctx with revokes [revokeS]). opens: openOrgKeyRing(ring, recipient, X-Wing secret from kemSeedHex) returns keyHex. audit: verifyOrgAuditExport(export, {genesisHash, now}).
